title: More Signal vs. More Noise - Comparing Full Text and Abstract as Inputs for Large Language Model-based Classification of Oncology Trial Eligibility Criteria

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'GPT-5 ... with snapshot "gpt-5-2025-08-07", temperature set to 1, and reasoning level set to high'; 'produced in a single batch run (without repetition) across all 200 trials'

prompt.location: Methods, 'LLM-based Classification' (system prompt printed verbatim; user prompt = the abstract or full text)

claim.metric: accuracy for the LOCAL (localized-disease eligibility) label, abstract input
claim.location: Table 1, abstract row for LOCAL: accuracy 0.86 (95% CI 0.81-0.91), F1 0.90

data.source: https://github.com/JuliaWy/Full-text-vs-Abstract (code, labels, dataset); abstracts public via PubMed, full-text PDFs paywalled

notes: Use the abstract arm (public inputs); the full-text arm (accuracy 0.92) needs licensed PDFs. Single run at temperature 1 with high reasoning effort.
